exposure: GDM retrospectively identified by the Norwegian-2017 criteria
GDM retrospectively identified by the WHO-2013 criteria
GDM diagnosed by the World Health Organization (WHO) 1999 criteria
Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis by different criteria (WHO 1999, WHO 2013, Norwegian 2017)
cohort: 2970 mother-child pairs from four Norwegian cohorts (2002-2013)
finding: Women diagnosed with GDM by WHO 2013 and Norwegian 2017 criteria but not diagnosed and treated by WHO 1999 criteria had an increased risk of LGA, cesarean section, and operative vaginal delivery compared to women without GDM.
mod_finding: Women identified by the WHO-2013 and Norwegian-2017 criteria but not diagnosed and treated by WHO-1999 criteria had an additional increased risk of cesarean section (OR 1.36, 95% CI 1.02,1.83 and 1.44, 95% CI 1.03,2.02, respectively) and operative vaginal delivery (OR 1.35, 95% CI 1.1,1.7 and 1.5, 95% CI 1.1,2.0, respectively).
